description: This file defines a set of tools for managing GitHub notifications, including listing notifications, dismissing individual notifications, marking all as read, retrieving notification details, and managing notification subscriptions at both thread and repository levels. It interacts with the GitHub API and uses JSON schemas for input validation.

methods.name: ListNotifications
methods.description: Creates a tool to list GitHub notifications for the current user, with filtering and pagination options.

methods.name: DismissNotification
methods.description: Creates a tool to mark a specific notification thread as read or done.

methods.name: MarkAllNotificationsRead
methods.description: Creates a tool to mark all notifications as read, optionally for a specific repository.

methods.name: GetNotificationDetails
methods.description: Creates a tool to retrieve detailed information for a specific notification thread.

methods.name: ManageNotificationSubscription
methods.description: Creates a tool to manage a notification thread subscription (ignore, watch, delete).

methods.name: ManageRepositoryNotificationSubscription
methods.description: Creates a tool to manage a repository notification subscription (ignore, watch, delete).
